items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: I'll tell you who was in the band then, Cliff Dudley. ... So Cliff Dudley was in the band.

ctx.x: saw where we were playing there and from Oklahoma, he just says well I got to go speak to him anyway.

So he came on and he said I may not stay for everything but I don't care what they say, preacher or anything, this band is different, I got to speak to you. So he came on to the dance. So we went to the station, the valet checked everything and out little bunch was kind of in a huddle talking, and this Muse was off by himself. I'll tell you who was in the band then, Cliff Dudley.
He's here; did you see him?
